reasons.text: About 58% of this county's corn follows corn. Here corn and soybean are a small share of the cropland, so rotations aren't compared.
In years with little rain from April to September, corn yields here tend to be about 10 bu/ac lower.
In years with a wet spring (planting delays), corn yields here tend to be about 4 bu/ac lower.

range_driver.text: What moves this county's corn range the most is season rain and water balance (Apr–Sep): from about -12 bu/ac in 2023 to about -2 bu/ac in 2016.
